outcome.description: committed: requested work is complete with new commits; no_changes: complete without new commits; needs_correction: unresolved fixable gaps remain; blocked: a prerequisite or human decision is missing; failed: execution cannot continue safely.

summary.description: Short session report. Completed changes, successful checks, and statements about actions not performed belong here, not in findings.

findings.description: Unresolved actionable problems only. Must be empty for committed or no_changes, and nonempty for needs_correction. Include each remaining problem and its issue requirement. Never include completed changes, passed checks, or statements about actions not performed.
